name: Ray-Layer Buffer Generation via Depth Peeling
definition: An algorithm to generate the ray-layer buffer by depth-peeling VOI definitions, grouping peeled fragments into ray layers based on VOI priority and material ID, using a custom stencil-like test inside a GPU program.
summary: Ray-Layer Buffer Generation via Depth Peeling creates ordered volume layers by performing stencil-like tests within a GPU program to preserve priority and material ID information.
